message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import struct

# Create a minimal SAV file with a long variable names record
# SAV file header
rec_type = b'\x24\x46\x4c\x32'  # $FL2
prod_name = b'SPSS PC+\x00'.ljust(60, b'\x00')
layout_code = struct.pack('<i', 2)  # little endian
nominal_case_size = struct.pack('<i', 0)
compression = struct.pack('<i', 0)
weight_index = struct.pack('<i', 0)
ncases = struct.pack('<i', 1)  # 1 case
bias = struct.pack('<d', 0.0)
creation_date = b'01 Jan 70'.ljust(9, b' ')
creation_time = b'00:00:00'.ljust(8, b' ')
file_label = b''.ljust(64, b' ')
padding = b'\x00\x00\x00'

header = rec_type + prod_name + layout_code + nominal_case_size + compression + weight_index + ncases + bias + creation_date + creation_time + file_label + padding

# Variable record (type 2)
var_type = struct.pack('<i', 0)  # numeric variable
has_var_label = struct.pack('<i', 0)
n_missing = struct.pack('<i', 0)
print_fmt = struct.pack('<i', 0x00000805)  # F5.0
write_fmt = struct.pack('<i', 0x00000805)
var_name = b'VAR00001'.ljust(8, b' ')
var_record = var_type + has_var_label + n_missing + print_fmt + write_fmt + var_name

# Dictionary termination record (type 999)
term_type = struct.pack('<i', 999)
filler = struct.pack('<i', 0)
term_record = term_type + filler

data = header + var_record + term_record

with open('/tmp/test_valid.sav', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)

print(f'Created valid SAV file with {len(data)} bytes')
"
